title: uxc fd.handler meta (fd/handlers/<Logical>/meta.json)
description: An operation handler registration (fd.handler, DESIGN §7.11). Every push deploys a fresh <Logical>_v<N>. script and filter resolve relative to the handler directory (../shared/ allowed).

$schema.description: Editor hint only: uxc ignores it (never hashed, never pushed).

action.description: Action tag: the operation that fires the handler (the _on<Action> suffix of the logical name).

objectType.description: ObjectType tag: the component category the handler listens on.

phase.description: ExecutionPhase (default AFTER). Only a BEFORE script can throw to abort the operation.

order.description: RegistrationOrder, an integer inside the manifest's fd.handler band (uxc add allocates it).

enabled.description: Enabled tag (default true). Use uxc disable/enable for the emergency switch.

script.description: Script path relative to the handler directory (default "handler.js"); ../shared/x.js shares one source between registrations.

filter.description: Optional request filter XML path relative to the handler directory (uploaded as the file named 'request'); null or absent = no filter.
